1.name: Rising Tornado
1.description:
Drayne spins his sword, damaging enemies in front of him and temporarily becoming stronger.

<color=FFFDED>Full Description</color>
Spins his sword and deals damage to enemies in front of him %hits% times.
When activated, the Hero grows in size and for %duration% increases his Physical Attack and the range of all his skills.

2.name: Shatter Strike
2.description:
Every %hits% basic attacks, Drayne deals damage to all enemies around him.

This strike counts as a basic attack.

3.name: Power Charge
3.description:
Buffs allies and attacks the nearest enemies.

<color=FFFDED>Full Description</color>
Drayne increases Crushing for himself and all allies behind him for %duration%, and attacks the nearest enemies in front of him.

4.name: Final Verdict
4.description:
Drayne’s attacks and skills now instantly kill enemies with low Health.

Enemies killed by him cannot be resurrected.

5.name: Shieldbreaker
5.description:
Deals physical damage to the closest enemy. All marked enemies also receive 30% of damage.
%name% regains some energy after killing an enemy with this skill.
Passive effect. Shielded enemies take 100% more damage from any of Oya's skills.

6.name: Hunting
6.description:
Marks the enemy with the lowest Health as "Hunter's prey" and lures them towards her. Any attacks on the marked target burn 4% of their energy.
Passive effect. Allied heroes who are healing themselves or receiving healing from Oya increase their critical hit chance for %duration%. Allied Nature Heroes receive an increased bonus.
The effect does not stack. Activating the skill again refreshes the duration of the effect.

7.name: Overwhelming
7.description:
Performs a series of 3 quick strikes. With each successive hit, the damage to the enemy increases.
Shielded enemies behind the main target receive a part of the skill's damage.

8.name: Brutal Onslaught
8.description:
When an allied hero deals critical damage or breaks an enemy shield, they restore Health.
Allied Nature Heroes receive an increased bonus.

9.name: Perfect Copy
9.description:
Conjures an inactive Shroom with a portion of its health missing. The copy has the hero's stats from the battle’s start. It can be targeted by attacks, offensive spells, and healing spells.
When the Shroom’s health is fully replenished for the first time, it activates. After that, it can attack and use all skills learned by the hero, but it won't be able to replenish energy.
You can summon no more than 5 Shrooms.

10.name: Branching Mycelium
10.description:
Conjures mycelium with 3 inactive Spore Mushrooms with a portion of their health missing. They can be targeted by attacks, offensive spells, and healing spells. Their max health is 30% of the hero's health at the battle’s start.
Once the mushroom's health is fully replenished, it runs towards the enemies and explodes, dealing damage and spreading a Mushroom Spore cloud within a short range. The cloud silences those caught within its range for %duration%.
Nearby enemies not affected by Mushroom Spores yet are prioritized when selecting the target.

11.name: Rotting Seeds
11.description: Damages the nearest enemy. The damage is increased for each point of healing received by allies since this skill was last activated.

12.name: Wild Growth
12.description:
Passive skill. Mushy heals inactive Shrooms and Spore Mushrooms.
This effects stacks for every active Shroom on the battlefield.

13.name: Meowsterpiece of Defense
13.description:
Protects his team with a Shield that absorbs any damage. When the Shield is destroyed or expires, Julius and all allies are healed.

Way of Progress Heroes receive twice as much healing.

14.name: Copycat Device
14.description:
Passive: Every time Julius gains a Shield, his Physical Attack increases until the end of the battle. The bonus is based on his Physical Attack at the start of the battle.

Active: Julius protects himself with a Shield that absorbs any damage. If the Shield is not destroyed within %duration%, its remaining durability is copied to each ally.

15.name: Nine-Lives Engine
15.description: When a Shield on Julius or an ally is destroyed or expires, that Hero gains bonus Armor and Magic Defense for %duration%. All negative effects are also removed from that Hero.

16.name: Purrfect Reflexes
16.description:
Speeds up attacks and skills of all allies protected by a Shield.

Way of Progress Heroes receive an increased bonus.

17.name: Dance of Death
17.description: Yasmine paralyzes the enemy with the lowest armor for %duration%, leaps to strike them from behind %hits% times, and applies an Assassin's Mark. While Dance of Death is active, Yasmine is immune to debuffs. When it ends, she continues attacking the marked enemy with basic attacks.

18.name: Assassin's Instinct
18.description: When Dance of Death is activated, %name%'s critical hit chance and Dodge are increased for %duration%.

19.name: Embrace of Pain
19.description: Yasmine's critical hits poison the enemy. When poison is re-applied to a poisoned enemy, the duration of the poison debuff is refreshed, and the damage stacks up to %hits% times.

20.name: Unknown Toxin
20.description: Blocks a portion of healing received by enemies poisoned by %name%.

21.name: Battle Rush
21.description: Every %param_skillcd% seconds, Drayne increases his speed by %hits%% for %duration%.

22.name: Rising Tornado
22.description: The duration of the Physical Attack and skill radius increase is %param_duration2%.

23.name: Shatter Strike
23.description: Reduces the main stat of enemies hit by the skill for %duration%.

24.name: Crushing Force
24.description: As long as Drayne is alive, Crushing always applies for him and his allies, regardless of enemy Health.

25.name: Lethal Sting
25.description:
Every %duration% deals physical damage to the enemy with the lowest current health.

The skill always deals critical damage.

26.name: Dance of Death
26.description: After Dance of Death ends, Yasmine remains immune to negative effects for an additional %tertiary% seconds.

27.name: Embrace of Pain
27.description: For every critical hit, Yasmine gains %tertiary% bonus energy.

28.name: Shadow Waltz
28.description:
If Yasmine loses a large amount of health from a single enemy attack, she dodges all incoming attacks for a few seconds.

<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
If Yasmin loses more than %hits%% of her maximum health from a single enemy attack, she dodges all incoming attacks for %duration%.

The effect can trigger no more than once every %param_innerCD% seconds.

29.name: Blades of Shadow
29.description:
Strikes enemies from behind with a series of attacks.

<color=FFFDED>Full Description</color>
Disappears into the shadows and delivers a series of strikes, appearing behind enemies.
Each hit deals more damage than the last one.

Cannot be targeted by enemy attacks or abilities while the skill is active.

30.name: Predator Jump
30.description:
Delivers two strikes. Shielded enemies take increased damage and receive the Mark of Fate if it has been learned.

<color=FFFDED>Full Description</color>
Attacks the nearest enemy and strikes them twice.
Enemies with shields take increased damage and are afflicted with the Mark of Fate, if it has been learned.

31.name: Royal Roar
31.description:
Increases Critical Hit Chance of the Hero and the ally with the highest Physical Attack.

<color=FFFDED>Full Description</color>
Increases Critical Hit Chance of the Hero and the ally with the highest Physical Attack.

If Leonel has the highest Physical Attack, the effect is applied only to him.
In this case, his Critical Hit Chance is increased even further, and his Critical Damage is increased.

32.name: Mark of Fate
32.description:
Critical attacks apply a mark that drains enemy's Energy. The higher the Critical Damage multiplier, the stronger the effect.

The mark can stack multiple times.
The chance to apply the mark is reduced if the enemy’s level is higher than %level%.

33.name: Runes of Ice
33.description: Creates 5 Runes of Ice that damage the closest enemy and slow them. If the enemy dies, the remaining Runes are applied to the enemy behind the original target.

34.name: Rune of Life
34.description:
Creates a Rune of Life that heals allies each second.

<color=FFFDED>Full Description</color>
For %duration%, creates a Rune of Life that restores Health to all allies. While it is active, all healing received by any allied Heroes from the Way of Nature is doubled.

35.name: Rune of Fire
35.description: Creates a Rune of Fire that damages two closest enemies.

36.name: Rune of Earth
36.description:
For %duration%, creates a Rune of Earth that decreases the basic attack damage received by allies. 

The Way of Nature Heroes always receive decreased basic attack damage.

37.name: Rune of Wind
37.description:
Creates a Rune of Wind, reducing cooldowns of allies’ skills.

<color=FFFDED>Full Description</color>
Every %param_SkillCooldown% sec. for %duration% applies a Rune of Wind to allies in front of Alvanor and to all Heroes of the Way of Nature. While active, the Rune reduces cooldowns of their skills.

38.name: Rune of Fire
38.description:
The Rune of Fire applies a mark to an enemy that deals damage over time.

<color=FFFDED>Full Description</color>
Hitting an enemy with the Rune of Fire applies a mark for %duration%. While the mark is active, it deals damage every second.

39.name: Rune of Earth
39.description:
The Rune of Earth now reduces damage received by Heroes from skills and basic attacks. 

The Way of Nature Heroes always take reduced damage from basic attacks.

40.name: Rune of Infinity
40.description: Increases the duration of effects applied by Alvanor.

41.name: Strike of the Damned
41.description: Corvus strikes enemy front line, dealing physical damage and temporarily decreasing all types of defense: Armor, Magic Defense, and Dodge. Increases the effectiveness of defense reduction and damage dealt by 10% for each allied Eternity Hero in the team.

42.name: Unity of the Damned
42.description: Corvus increases the physical and magic attack of allied Eternity Heroes for 10 seconds.

43.name: Altar of Souls
43.description: Corvus conjures an altar behind his team. The altar damages enemies whenever they deal damage to allied heroes. The altar's health decreases when allies take damage.

44.name: Royal Defense
44.description: When an ally's health drops below 20%, Corvus moves them to the center of the team. Can be triggered once every 8 seconds.

45.name: Power of the Tombs
45.description:
%name% activates an ancient relic. All enemies receive damage, while allies under the relic's effect restore health.

Passive effect: Lara Croft's basic attacks fire 2 shots.

46.name: Critical Thinking
46.description: %name% focuses for %duration%, increasing her critical hit chance and critical hit damage.

47.name: Steady Shot
47.description: %name% fires an explosive arrow at the central enemy. All enemies in the explosion radius receive damage and are stunned for %duration%.

48.name: Lost Knowledge
48.description:
%name% increases her physical attack for the duration of the battle, unearths a random artifact shard, and embeds it into her artifact weapon. Subsequent uses of the ultimate ability additionally activate the effect of the unearthed artifact.

Possible artifact bonuses: magic attack, armor, magic defense, armor penetration, magic penetration, critical hit chance, dodge.

Bonuses cannot repeat.

The power of the bonus depends on the current level of the hero's artifact.

49.name: Paralysis
49.description:
Paralyzes the enemy with the highest Magic Attack, dealing damage to them. The paralyzed enemy cannot move or attack.
Reduces Attack of all enemies.

<color=FFFDED>Full Description</color>
Paralyzes the enemy with the highest Magic Attack for %duration%, dealing damage every 0.5 sec. The paralyzed enemy cannot move or attack.

Magic and Physical Attack of all enemies are reduced for %hits% sec.

While this skill is active, Phobos can't use other skills.

50.name: Dreaded Shadow
50.description: Reduces Magic Defense of the enemy with the highest Magic Attack for %duration% and deals damage to them.

51.name: Bonds of Darkness
51.description: Bonds of Darkness binds Phobos and the enemy with the highest magic attack stat for %duration%, transferring all energy gained by the target to Phobos.

52.name: Curse Master
52.description:
When a cursed enemy uses a skill, Phobos deals damage to them. The more Curses on the enemy, the higher the damage.

Only affects enemies that Phobos starts the battle with.

53.name: Chains of Fear
53.description: Paralyzes the nearest enemy for %hits% seconds every %duration%, starting %param_firstAction% seconds into battle.

54.name: Paralysis
54.description: Each consecutive hit increases the skill's damage. When the effect expires, paralyzes enemies around the target for %param_paralysis% sec.

55.name: Dreaded Shadow
55.description: Now reduces Magic Defense even further. Once it reaches zero, the enemy takes bonus damage.

56.name: Seal of Exhaustion
56.description:
Curses the enemy with the highest Energy, burning a portion of it whenever they reach max Energy.

<color=FFFDED>Full Description</color>
Curses the enemy with the highest Energy %duration% after a battle begins. When the target reaches max Energy, Phobos burns a portion of it. Upon the target's death or when the Curse triggers, it transfers to the enemy with the highest Energy after %duration%.

57.name: Enchantment
57.description:
Charms all enemies, putting them to sleep for %duration%. Sleeping enemies wake up when damaged.

Lian's attacks do not wake enemies.

58.name: Hypnotic Ball
58.description: Launches a projectile that explodes and deals Pure damage 5 times to each of the front-line enemy Heroes.

59.name: Wandering Lights
59.description: Creates %hits% magical spheres and launches them at the nearest enemy, dealing magical damage.

60.name: Conciliation
60.description: Passive skill. Enemies that attempt to deal damage to %name% are charmed for %duration%.

61.name: Enthrall
61.description:
Periodically Charms central enemies. Already Charmed enemies take Pure damage, while the others fall asleep.

<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
Every %duration% Charms the central enemy and nearby Heroes.
Already Charmed enemies take Pure damage, while the others fall asleep for %param_CharmDuration% seconds.

62.name: Enchantment
62.description:
Charmed enemies have a %param_Chance%% chance not to wake up when attacked.
Each time the skill triggers, this chance decreases by %param_ChanceIncrement%%.

63.name: Wandering Lights
63.description: Damage from Wandering Lights becomes Pure and is increased.

64.name: Heartbreak
64.description: When Charmed enemies are attacked, Lian deals additional Pure damage to them.

65.name: Rapid Fire
65.description: Shoots the nearest target 5 times, increasing damage by 25% with each subsequent shot.

66.name: Big Badda Boom!
66.description: Throws a bomb at the center of the enemy team, damaging all enemies in the blast radius. The bomb always deals crit damage.

67.name: Fire Support
67.description: Performs an extra basic attack after an ally behind Daredevil successfully attacks.

68.name: Thirst for Blood
68.description: Each critical hit by Daredevil increases her Physical attack for the duration of the battle.

69.name: Heavy Caliber
69.description: Fires a huge projectile at the nearest target, dealing physical damage and throwing the target back.

70.name: Smoke Screen
70.description: Fires a smoke grenade into the enemy's front row, blinding nearby heroes for %duration%. The Heavy Caliber skill now also blinds the enemy's front row.

72.name: Concussion
72.description: Passive skill. Heavy Caliber stuns the target for %duration%.

73.name: Phoenix Ritual
73.description:
Aidan sacrifices 20% of his maximum Health, then boosts maximum and current Health of his allies and sets them on fire. Burning Heroes receive damage over time equal to their bonus Health for %duration%. If allied Kayla is dead, she'll be resurrected. 
Aidan's skills don't deal damage to allied Heroes if their Health is below 25%.

74.name: Fire Embrace
74.description: Heals the hero with the lowest health on the team and all heroes on the team who lost health from friendly skills since the last time this skill was applied. Chaos Heroes gain more healing.

75.name: Bonds of Fire
75.description: Aidan deals damage to the ally with the highest Health percentage, as well as all other allies who have more than 80% of Health, equal to 2.5% of their maximum Health, then increases his maximum and current Health by the amount of Health sacrificed by his allies and heals himself.

76.name: Flame Shield
76.description: When Aidan or an ally that he started the fight with has less than 30% health left, Aidan creates a powerful shield around that hero that absorbs physical and magical damage for %duration%. The shield durability depends on the total maximum health of the team's heroes. This skill can be only applied once every %hits% seconds to each ally.

77.name: Doppelganger
77.description: Turns into the enemy or ally who last used their first skill, then uses that skill.

78.name: Power Throw
78.description: Lifts the closest enemy off the ground and slams them into the center of the enemy team. Stuns enemies and deals damage to targets in range.

79.name: Chain Lightning
79.description: Throws a ricocheting magic missile that hits %hits% enemies. Deals damage and lowers the targets´ physical attack for %duration%.

80.name: Spell Expert
80.description: Passive skill. Increases the team´s magic defense.

81.name: Nexus of Horror
81.description: %name% throws into the air three enemies with the lowest health. When the affected enemies fall back down, they get stunned for %duration%.

82.name: Negator of Laws
82.description: %name% opens an interdimensional rift that can block enemy physical attacks for %duration%. The hero gets extra energy for each attack blocked.

83.name: Deadly Tendrils
83.description: While %name% is alive, he targets every enemy knocked up in the air. May deal double damage.

84.name: Survival Factor
84.description: Attacks against enemies thrown into the air heal the hero for a fraction of the damage dealt.

85.name: Pulsing Comet
85.description: Launches an ice comet behind the enemy team, stunning all enemies for %duration% and dealing damage to them every 0.5 sec. The further enemies are from the landing site, the shorter the effect duration.

86.name: Glacial Fortress
86.description: Creates an ice obstacle on the battlefield. When enemies attack the obstacle, %name% gets %secondary% Energy. The obstacle can withstand %hits% hits before exploding. The explosion stuns nearby enemies for %duration% and deals damage.

87.name: Shooting Star
87.description:
Throws a star shard into the center of the enemy team. All enemies around the shard are stunned for %duration% and take damage.

The area of effect increases by %secondary%% for every Way of Progress ally aside from %name%.

88.name: Aurora Borealis
88.description: When %name% or her ally stuns an enemy who’s already stunned, a radiance effect is applied for %duration%. An afflicted enemy takes increased magic damage. Damage from Progress heroes is higher.

89.name: Ravenous Pack
89.description:
Satori's basic attacks deal damage and apply marks to enemies. The skill deals damage for each mark and grants Satori immunity to negative effects.

<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
The Hero’s basic attacks deal magic damage and apply Fox Fire marks to enemies. When the skill is activated, enemies take damage for each mark on them. Satori is immune to all negative effects while the skill is active.

90.name: Spirit Banishment
90.description:
Attacks all enemies and applies marks to them. Applies an additional mark for each ally of the Way of Mystery.

<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
Satori attacks all enemies, dealing damage and applying a Fox Fire mark. Applies an additional mark for each allied Mystery Hero, up to %param_maxCountStackMystics% marks at a time.

91.name: Centurial Wisdom
91.description:
Steals Intelligence from enemies, increasing his own. Basic attacks restore Satori’s Health points.

<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
Each successful attack steals Intelligence from the target and adds it to Satori. The effect lasts until the end of the battle and cannot be removed. Satori cannot steal more Intelligence than the target has.

Heals himself for %secondary%% of the damage dealt by his basic attacks.

92.name: Looming Justice
92.description:
When an enemy gains bonus Energy, Satori applies Fox Fire marks to them.

Energy gained from incoming damage, basic attacks, skills, or kills is not considered bonus Energy.

93.name: Awakening
93.description: Turns into a demon, which increases critical hit chance and attack speed. While in the demonic form, Ishmael slowly expends energy. When it reaches 0, he loses his demonic form.

96.name: Storm Blades
96.description: Every %hits%th hit stuns the opponent for %duration%.

97.name: Deadly Shower
97.description: %name% makes 10 shots with lightning speed, striking enemies with a rain of arrows. Shoots one extra arrow for each time another ally has used their first skill, or two extra arrows if the ally was an Honor Hero.

98.name: True Light
98.description:
Creates a flash of light in front of her that damages enemies caught in it and blinds them for %duration%. 
Passive effect: When %name% attacks a blinded or stunned enemy, she deals extra damage.

99.name: Smart Arrow
99.description: Whenever an enemy is blinded or stunned, Artemis attacks them an additional time. If there is more than one such enemy, the farthest one is targeted. Can be triggered once per %cooldown%.

100.name: Punishing Arrows
100.description: Passive skill. %name% boosts her Physical Attack. The boost scales with the total current health of her allies.

101.name: Titan's Fist
101.description: %name% strikes the nearest enemy with a giant fist, dealing damage and stunning the target and nearby enemies for %duration%.

102.name: Living Earth
102.description:
Passive skill. While Andvari is alive, he protects all allies behind him from all displacement and knock-up effects.
This skill only has effect on Heroes Andvari started the battle with.

103.name: Stone Grasp
103.description: Summons a stone hand that grabs the lowest-health enemy. The hand deals physical damage, stuns the target, and binds it to the ground for %duration%.

104.name: Nature's Barrier
104.description: Applies a protective barrier that absorbs physical and pure damage to the ally with the lowest Armor. The hero protected by the barrier gains bonus energy for all damage absorbed, and can still dodge enemy attacks while under the barrier's effect.

105.name: Divine Protection
105.description:
Markus heals the most injured ally and protects them from damage.

<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
Markus heals the ally with the lowest Health and grants them immunity to all damage for %duration%.

106.name: Retribution Ray
106.description: Markus damages enemies and heals allies in front of him and behind him.

107.name: Compassion
107.description: Deals damage to the nearest enemies in front of him and stuns them for %duration%.

108.name: Ascension
108.description:
Markus temporarily becomes a spirit after death. He absorbs a part of the damage taken by allies while continuing to use his skills.

<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
After death, Markus becomes a spirit and continues to use his skills but no longer gains Energy. He absorbs %prime%% of the damage taken by allies until reaching the absorption limit, after which he disappears.

While this skill is active, Markus cannot be targeted by skills or attacks.

109.name: Army of Graven
109.description:
Morrigan summons 6 skeletons, treated as Eternity Heroes, to her side to fight in the front row. She can control up to 10 skeletons at any given time.
The skeletons have the same Armor and Magic Defense stats as Morrigan when they are summoned.

110.name: Bone Armor
110.description: Morrigan summons 2 skeletons and applies temporary protection to allied Eternity Heroes, increasing their Armor and Magic Defense for %duration% and healing them. This skill is half as effective for Heroes from other factions.

111.name: Empathy of Eternity
111.description: Morrigan summons 2 skeletons and applies the Empathy effect to allied Eternity Heroes for %duration%. The effect spreads a portion of damage taken evenly among all skeletons.

112.name: Necromancy
112.description:
Each time an enemy dies, Morrigan summons 1 skeleton from their body.
Cancels any resurrection attempt on the battlefield. Whenever an enemy attempts resurrection, Morrigan receives 1 Soul Essence charge.
When an ally dies, Morrigan spends 1 Soul Essence charge to resurrect them.

113.name: Soul Burning
113.description:
Iris gains Pure Soul charges and damages all enemies. Enemies with low Health die.

<color=FFFDED>Full Description</color>
Iris gains Pure Soul charges for each buffed ally and debuffed enemy.
The more charges she has, the bigger her damage Enemies with low Health die from the skill.

Heroes killed with this skill cannot be resurrected.

114.name: Otherworldly Creature
114.description:
Bitey weakens enemies, lowering their Magic Defense for a while and extending debuffs.

<color=FFFDED>Full Description</color>
Iris’ familiar, Bitey, weakens enemies and lowers their Magic Defense for %duration%. 
Extends all debuffs on the target for %duration%, both active beforehand and applied during the skill’s duration.

115.name: Mysterious Pact
115.description:
Iris becomes immune to debuffs. If an enemy weakens an ally or applies a mark to them, Iris lowers the enemy’s Physical and Magic Attack.

<color=FFFDED>Full Description</color>
Iris becomes permanently immune to debuffs. When an enemy weakens an ally or applies a mark to them, she lowers the enemy’s Physical and Magic Attack for %duration%.

This cannot trigger on a single target more often than once every %param_param% seconds.

116.name: Inner Fire
116.description:
Burns enemies whenever a debuff is applied to them, and creates an Inner Fire charge that deals damage.

<color=FFFDED>Full Description</color>
Whenever a debuff is applied to an enemy, Iris burns them with an Inner Fire charge that deals damage per second while the debuff is active.

If the effect is applied by an Eternity Hero, the charge’s damage doubles.

A target cannot have more than %hits% Inner Fire charges at the same time.

117.name: Soul Agony
117.description: Iris weakens the nearest enemy every %hits% seconds and prevents them from using their first skill.

118.name: Otherworldly Creature
118.description: Bitey now reduces Magic Defense for %hits% seconds.

119.name: Inner Fire
119.description:
Inner Fire charge limit is now increased to %param_param%.

If the effect is applied by an Eternity Hero, its damage doubles.

120.name: Curse of Weakness
120.description: Iris’ Soul Burning skill and basic attacks extend all debuffs on the target for %duration%.

121.name: Chronostasis
121.description:
Stops time for all enemies. For %duration%, they cannot use skills, move, or dodge attacks, and their Armor and Magic Defense are reduced. For the duration of this skill, the cooldown of all enemy skills that have it will be frozen.
This skill increases the duration of all curses and debuffs cast on the enemies.

122.name: Withering
122.description: Weakens distant opponents in front of the Hero for %duration%. Weakened enemies lose Physical attack and max Health.

123.name: Temporal Anomaly
123.description: Sends the enemy with the highest Armor Penetration into the Temporal Anomaly for %duration%. The target is slowed down by 25%, losing %secondary% energy per second and receiving magic damage.

124.name: Time Paradox
124.description: For %duration%, conjures a huge Clock in the center of the arena. Enemies in range of the Clock are slowed down, while allies are sped up. Affected allies' max Health is also increased.

125.name: Chrono Field
125.description: Every %hits% sec creates an aura around Tempus for %duration%, increasing Magic Penetration for him and all allies within the area.

126.name: Withering
126.description: Now also debuffs all enemies in front of him.

127.name: Time Paradox
127.description: Now all enemies in the skill's area take damage every %hits% seconds.

128.name: Time Rebound
128.description: Applies the Chronostasis skill for %duration% to the enemy that inflicts a Control effect on Tempus.

129.name: Under the Wing
129.description:
Restores Health and gives a Golden Feather to each of his allies.
Passive effect:  Golden Feather raises an ally’s Critical hit chance for %duration%. If Golden Feather is applied to an ally again, the duration of this effect is extended by %duration%.

130.name: Feather Squad
130.description:
Gives a Golden Feather to each ally in front of him.
While an ally has a Golden Feather, their Health is restored each time they receive damage from enemies.

131.name: Beak Peak
131.description:
If Health of an ally with a Golden Feather is supposed to drop below 25%, then before that happens, it is partially restored. The amount of Health restored is increased for each remaining second of the Golden Feather’s duration.
The Golden Feather disappears after triggering this effect.

132.name: Honkageddon
132.description:
Hero’s critical hits do not deal extra damage now but restore Health to all allies around the target and give them Golden Feathers.
If an ally has a Golden Feather, all their critical hits deal increased damage, and Honor Heroes deal extra damage depending on their current Health.

133.name: Lullaby Veil
133.description:
Puts all enemies to sleep. After waking up, they gain the Drowsiness effect and deal less Physical Damage.

<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
Puts all enemies to sleep for %duration%. Sleeping enemies are inactive and wake up upon taking damage.

When awakened, they gain 1 stack of the Drowsiness effect for %hits% sec. While under this effect, they deal reduced Physical Damage.

The maximum number of Drowsiness stacks that an enemy can be affected by at the same time is 3.

134.name: Drowsy Blessing
134.description:
The nearest ally applies Drowsiness to enemies on hit. The effect now reduces both physical damage and Armor penetration.

<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
The nearest ally in front of Somna for %duration% applies 1 stack of Drowsiness effect to enemies on hit.
Mystery Heroes apply the effect for %hits% seconds longer.

Drowsiness effect now reduces both physical damage and Armor penetration.

135.name: Curse of the Wool
135.description:
Applies Drowsiness to nearby enemies and deals damage. May turn them into helpless sheep.

<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
Applies 1 stack of Drowsiness effect to nearby enemies in front and deals damage to each of them.

If an enemy has 3 stacks of Drowsiness when the skill is used, they are transformed into a sheep for %duration%. 
A sheep cannot attack and tries to flee.

After returning to normal form, the Hero cannot be transformed into a sheep again for 10.0 sec.

136.name: Silence of the Sheep
136.description:
When taking damage, applies Drowsiness and instantly turns the attacker into a sheep.

<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
When taking damage, applies %hits% stack(s) of the Drowsiness effect to the attacking enemy and instantly transforms them into a sheep.

When allied Heroes attack the sheep, they deal additional Physical Damage.

137.name: Twilight Herd
137.description:
While Somna is not under any control effects, she can transform the farthest enemy into a sheep.

<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
If Somna is free from control effects, every %duration% she turns the farthest enemy into a sheep for %hits% seconds.

138.name: Lullaby Veil
138.description:
Upon Awakening, more Drowsiness stacks are applied to the enemy, and the maximum number of stacks on a single target is increased.

<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
If Sleep is broken by damage, the enemy instantly receives 3 stacks of the Drowsiness effect.

The maximum number of Drowsiness stacks is increased to 10.

139.name: Curse of the Wool
139.description:
Applies more Drowsiness stacks and deals additional damage for each stack on the target.

<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
Somna applies %hits% stacks of Drowsiness and deals extra damage to enemies for each Drowsiness stack they have.

140.name: Eternal Sleep
140.description:
Can transform enemies into sheep more often.

<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
An enemy can be turned into a sheep again after 5.0 seconds.

141.name: Inkblot
141.description:
Creates a Blot above the center of the area where the enemy team is standing, which grows in size for %duration%. 
When it is fully formed or the ability is interrupted, the Blot will come crashing down on the enemies and deal area magical damage. The damage increases for every 0.5 sec of growing.

142.name: Ancient Scriptures
142.description:
Covers the closest enemy with Ancient Writings for %duration% and deals magic damage. This enemy covered in Ancient Writings is unable to move.
Once the effect ends, the target and all the nearby enemies receive additional damage.

143.name: Ink Copy
143.description:
Creates an Ink Copy in front of allies. The Copy cannot move and has a percentage of Folio’s Health, Magic penetration, and Magic Attack. Each stat also receives an additional increase for every allied Mystery Hero apart from Folio itself. The Copy has 0 Armor and Magic Defense.
When enemies attack the Copy, all nearby allies gain %hits% Energy as a bonus.
Healing, buffs, and debuffs have no effect on the Copy.

144.name: Curse of Knowledge
144.description:
For %duration%, steals Intelligence from the enemy with the highest Intelligence. Once the effect ends, all enemies are drawn to the target.
It cannot steal more Intelligence than the target has.

145.name: Echo Chant
145.description:
Casts a spell every few seconds, dealing damage to an enemy. With each cast, Critical Hit Chance and the skill's damage increase.

<color=FFFDED>Full Description</color>
Casts a spell every %duration%, dealing damage to the nearest enemy. With each cast, the ability’s Critical Hit Chance increases by %hits%%, and its damage also increases.

Cannot cast if under a control effect.

146.name: Inkblot
146.description:
Skill damage increases every 0.25 seconds. The final skill damage is now increased.

<color=FFFDED>Full Description</color>
Creates a Blot above the enemy team’s center and charges it for %duration%.

When the Blot is completed or the skill is interrupted, it crashes down on enemies, dealing area magic damage. While charging, the Blot’s damage increases every 0.25 seconds. The final skill damage is now increased.

147.name: Ink Copy
147.description:
Now Ink Copy receives all damage instead of Folio.

<color=FFFDED>Full Description</color>
Now Ink Copy can be healed and buffed. While the Copy is alive, it receives all damage instead of Folio.

148.name: Know-It-All
148.description:
Increased damage from attacks and abilities against enemies with lower Intelligence than Folio.

<color=FFFDED>Full Description</color>
If Folio's Intelligence is higher than the enemy’s, Folio’s attack and skills damage is increased by %prime%%.

149.name: Tes'Lin's Overdrive
149.description: Tes'Lin launches an electrical charge forward, dealing physical damage to all enemies affected.

150.name: Observer Drones
150.description: Isaac launches drones that increase Physical Attack for him and allies behind for %duration%. Observer Drones also increase Armor Penetration for Progress Heroes.

151.name: Shield Drones
151.description: Isaac launches drones that cast a shield over him and allies ahead. The shield absorbs both physical and magical damage until its destruction. Shield Drones also heal Progress Heroes under their protection.

152.name: High-Voltage Module
152.description: Tes'Lin's Overdrive pushes all enemies away, damaging their Armor. Pushed enemies lose Armor for %duration%. The enemy closest to Isaac is pushed away twice.

153.name: Hydrokinesis
153.description:
%name% unleashes a heavy downpour, damaging enemies each second for %duration% and inflicting status effects depending on their main stat.

Strength: Deals physical damage, decreasing Armor and Magic Defense.
Agility: Deals magic damage, blinding the target.
Intelligence: Deals physical damage, silencing the target.

154.name: Tidal Wave
154.description:
%name% dashes through enemy lines, dealing magic damage and knocking back enemies. The knockback is more effective against nearby enemies.
Reaching the end of the dash, %name% returns to a new position at the same range as the original distance from the furthest enemy.

155.name: Refluence
155.description:
After casting Tidal Wave, %name% inflicts the Sodden Armor status effect on enemies hit on the way back. The effect lasts for %duration%.
Whenever the afflicted enemy takes damage, Sodden Armor deals extra damage of the same type.
If the damage was dealt by an allied Mystery Hero, the afflicted enemy takes increased damage.

156.name: Elemental Surge
156.description:
%name%'s Magic Defense penetration is always equal to his Armor penetration value. When one of these stats is affected in battle, the other changes as well.

The type of damage from %name%'s basic attacks changes with the target's defense stats. If the target's Armor is greater than their Magic Defense, they will take magic damage, and if not, they will take physical damage instead.

If the hero's basic attack penetrates the target's Armor or Magic Defense, the target will also take the other type of damage in an extra attack. If the extra attack penetrates the associated defense, the target also takes pure damage.

157.name: Deathflower
157.description:
Summons a flower in the middle of the enemy team that spreads poisonous pollen and applies 5 stacks of Toxin to enemies in the effective area, then deals damage to the affected targets, scaling with the stacks of Toxin on all enemies in the battle. 
Toxin deals damage to the enemy for %duration% and stacks on each target up to 10 times.

158.name: Poison Mastery
158.description:
The hero's basic attacks apply one stack of Toxin to the opponent whenever they hit or are absorbed by a shield.
Every stack of Toxin removed from an opponent before its full duration deals damage. If an opponent removes a stack, they take the same damage as well.
Enemies take extra damage for each stack, scaling with the number of allied Mystery Heroes.

159.name: Snake Charmer
159.description:
Releases a snake that removes all stacks of Toxin from the nearest enemy, then attacks the furthest enemy and applies the same number of stacks of Toxin to them.
The snake also applies half as many stacks to any opponents it passes by.

160.name: Detrimental Effect
160.description: Whenever an opponent affected by stacks of Toxin uses a skill that applies a shield or increases health on another enemy hero, all stacks of Toxin are removed from them. When those stacks are removed, the same number of stacks is applied to every target of the skill.

161.name: Careless Wish
161.description:
Amira buries her foes under mounds of cursed gold. After %duration% the curse is released from the gold and deals damage based on its health. Each time an opponent deals damage, they also deal the same damage to their mound of gold.
Each allied Mystery Hero other than Amira raises the gold’s Health by 10%.

162.name: Fair Deal
162.description: Amira makes a “fair deal” with those enemies that have Agility as their main stat. Their critical hits become critical fumbles for %duration% and their critical hit chance increases. Critical fumbles deal half as much damage as a regular attack.

163.name: Genie’s Patronage
163.description: Amira activates Patronage for %duration%, protecting her allies. While Patronage is active, allies ignore part of the magic damage dealt by enemies whose main stat is Intelligence. Patronage is always active for Mystery Heroes.

164.name: Endurance Test
164.description: Amira challenges enemies whose main stat is Strength, burning 5% of their maximum energy. If their maximum Health is low, this skill burns 50% of their maximum energy instead.

165.name: Cowabunga
165.description:
All Ninja Turtles cleanse themselves of control effects and disappear from the battlefield. Then, the Turtles (those who can participate in combat) re-enter the fight one by one, performing their Signature Moves. After their moves are executed, only the Turtles who were there before the ability activation remain on the battlefield.

<color=#FFFDED>Additional Effect:</color> Ninja Turtles join the battle shortly after its beginning. Leo is the first to enter the fray performing his Signature Move.

<color=#FFFDED>Leo's Signature Move:</color> Leaps into the center of the enemy team, spinning with his katanas and dealing damage per second to enemies in the area for %duration%. Afterward, he leaps back to the front line of the allied team.

166.name: Donnie's Tactics
166.description:
<color=#FFFDED>Passive Effect:</color> Every %hits% seconds, a new Ninja Turtle (one of those whose abilities are unlocked) appears on the battlefield and performs his Signature Move. The Turtle fights for %duration% before leaving the battle. The Ninja Turtles share a common Health and Energy pool. The Turtles' Maximum Health cannot be altered during the battle.

<color=#FFFDED>Additional Effect:</color> Donnie now joins the battle and performs his Signature Move.

<color=#FFFDED>Donnie's Signature Move:</color> Strikes the frontmost enemy with his staff, dealing damage and stunning them for 1 second. Then, he pushes the target back to the center of the enemy team. The pushed enemy and any enemies they collide with also take damage.

167.name: Raph's Fury
167.description:
<color=#FFFDED>Passive Effect:</color> Every %hits% basic attack from each Ninja Turtle is now enhanced: it deals %secondary%% additional damage and stuns the target for %duration%.

<color=#FFFDED>Additional Effect:</color> Raph now joins the battle and performs his Signature Move.

<color=#FFFDED>Raph's Signature Move:</color> Leaps behind the farthest enemy and pushes them towards the center of the enemy team, dealing damage. Then, he jumps back to the front line of the allied team, throwing his sai at all enemies mid-air, dealing damage to each.

168.name: Mikey's Optimism
168.description:
<color=#FFFDED>Passive Effect:</color> As long as there is more than one Ninja Turtle on the battlefield, all of them take 25% less damage.

<color=#FFFDED>Additional Effect:</color> Mikey now joins the battle and performs his Signature Move.

<color=#FFFDED>Mikey's Signature Move:</color> Leaps behind the farthest enemy and rides his skateboard towards his allies, holding a pizza in hand. Along the way, he crashes into the central enemy, dealing damage to enemies in the area and stunning them for %duration%. He also scatters pizza slices, healing allies. Afterward, he jumps back to the front line of the allied team.

169.name: Queen of Flowers
169.description: A magical flower grows around Maya, protecting her from any attacks. Unless it is destroyed, the flower will restore health of all teammates over time.

170.name: Poisoned Pollen
170.description: Maya hits the most distant enemy with poisoned pollen that causes damage over time.

171.name: Poisonous Bonds
171.description: Living sprouts entangle enemies on the far left and the far right, pulling them to each other and poisoning them.

172.name: Queen's Revenge
172.description: Now, when the magical flower dies, its roots entangle the nearest enemies, preventing them from moving and causing damage over time for %duration%.

173.name: Life Drop
173.description:
Summons a bud that heals allies.

<color=FFFDED>Full Description</color>
Every %hits% seconds, summons a bud that heals the rightmost ally for %duration%.
Then it moves to another ally with the lowest Health, heals them, and disappears after %duration%.

174.name: Queen of Flowers
174.description: Maya’s flower now boosts Toughness of all allies while it’s active.

175.name: Queen's Revenge
175.description: Maya’s flower's roots now entangle and poison enemies not only when it’s destroyed but also when it appears.

176.name: Nature's Might
176.description:
Maya’s poison and healing now affect Heroes around the target.

<color=FFFDED>Full Description</color>
When an enemy is poisoned by a Maya’s skill, the poison also spreads to nearby enemies.
Healing effects now apply to allies standing around the main target.

177.name: You will not stop me
177.description: %name% becomes enraged for %duration%, significantly increasing his attack speed. While enraged, %name% cannot die.

178.name: I will take your life
178.description: Each of %name%'s attacks deals additional pure damage to the target while sacrificing %secondary%% of their own current health.

179.name: I see you
179.description: For a period of time %name%, increases his attack power and focuses his attacks on a ranged enemy.

180.name: The spirits will heal me
180.description: If %name% is not under control effects after the first skill is used, he regenerates some health.

181.name: Mark of Pain
181.description:
Applies a Mark of Pain to an enemy. All of Jhu’s basic attacks also strike the marked target.

<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
Activates 15 seconds after the start of battle. Every 20 seconds, applies a Mark of Pain to the farthest enemy for %duration%. While marked, all one of Jhu’s basic attacks against any enemy also hit the marked target.

182.name: You will not stop me
182.description:
While in a state of Rage, Jhu’s attacks reduce enemy Armor. Critical Hits reduce it even further.

<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
While in a state of Rage, Jhu’s attacks reduce enemy Armor for %hits% sec. Critical Hits reduce Armor twice as effectively.

183.name: I will take your life
183.description:
Jhu’s attacks deal extra Pure Damage to enemies under shields.

<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
When striking a shielded enemy, Jhu deals bonus Pure Damage based on the target’s Max Health.

184.name: Triple Fury
184.description: All of Jhu’s Critical Hits deal triple damage.

185.name: Totem of Wrath
185.description:
Creates a totem that shoots magic projectiles at the two closest enemies for %duration%. The skill lasts for 0.15 seconds longer for each Wrath of the Spirits charge.
%name% cannot attack or use skills during this time.

186.name: Healing Spirits
186.description:
Heals allies for %secondary%% of their maximum Health. 
If an ally is fully healed by this skill, they gain extra 10% of energy, and %name% gains a charge of Wrath of the Spirits.
Healed Nature Heroes gain 10% more energy.

187.name: Cursed Bones
187.description:
Shoots a projectile at a random enemy, dealing magic damage and stunning the target.
If an enemy burns or steals an ally’s energy, %name% uses this skill on that enemy, dealing extra damage for every Wrath of the Spirits charge.

188.name: Hex
188.description:
Curses the enemies Mojo started the battle with. Every %cooldown%, applies the Corruption mark to the Hero who took the most damage during that period.
This mark deals a portion of damage the target received during a %cooldown% period, equal to Mojo’s current Health percentage (no less than 20%).
If this skill kills an enemy, Mojo gains %hits% charges of Wrath.
If Mojo dies, this skill remains active and deals 20% of damage received by the target.

189.name: Vengeful Souls
189.description: Dark Star releases a wave that damages enemies and disables their buffing skills.

190.name: Forest Whisper
190.description:
Dark Star pushes away the nearest enemy, dealing damage to them and preventing them from moving for 3 seconds.
If the skill Black Arrows is learned, a mark is also applied to this enemy for %duration%.

191.name: Companion
191.description:
After each shot, Dark Star creates a shadow copy, which shoots at the enemy with the lowest health percentage.
The shadow copy also releases one arrow at each marked enemy.

192.name: Black Arrows
192.description:
Shoots at the two nearest enemies in front of her, dealing damage and marking them for %duration%.
Passive effect. Enemies marked by Dark Star receive 20% more damage from her allies. Damage from allied Nature Heroes is increased by 40%.

193.name: Demolition Robot
193.description: Summons a monster that charges at the first enemy it sees. The monster explodes, stunning opponents for %duration% and dealing damage.

194.name: Teleport
194.description: Jumps to the target with the lowest health, attacks it with claws, and jumps back.

195.name: Underground Strike
195.description: Strikes the closest enemy with spikes, dealing damage and stunning the target and enemies around them for %duration%.

196.name: Neurotoxin
196.description: Any damage received from Arachne, poisons the enemy for %duration%.

197.name: Total Overdrive
197.description:
The Hero enters a state, dealing Magic Damage and reducing enemies’ Magic Defense.

<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
Every 15 seconds enters an overdrive mode for %duration%. During this time, Arachne’s basic attacks deal Magic Damage instead of Physical Damage. Additionally, all her damage for %hits% seconds reduces enemy's’ Magic Defense.

198.name: Demolition Robot
198.description:
Summons another monster that attacks enemies.

<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
Summons a second monster after the first one. It charges into the farthest enemy, explodes, dealing damage to all enemies around them and stunning them for %hits% seconds.

199.name: Teleport
199.description: If this skill kills an enemy, it instantly refreshes its cooldown.

200.name: Destruction Protocol
200.description: Any Arachne’s attack that pierces Magic Defense becomes critical.

201.name: Ion Cyclone
201.description: Creates a lightning storm that deals magic damage to every enemy %hits% times.

202.name: Force Field
202.description: Casts a shield on the rightmost and leftmost allies. The shield absorbs all damage.

203.name: Spacial Rift
203.description: Creates a spacial rift in the middle of the enemy team for 7 seconds. The rift slows nearby enemies.

204.name: Enhanced Generator
204.description: Enhances Judge's skills. Ion Cyclone stuns enemies on hit. Force Field stuns nearby enemies once per 5 seconds. Spacial Rift stuns enemies on dissipation.

205.name: Fountain of Blood
205.description:
Applies the Fountain of Blood effect to enemies.
Allies’ attacks against affected enemies restore their Health.

<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
Applies the Fountain of Blood effect to the nearest enemy for %duration%. Allies’ attacks against that enemy restore their Health.
If the target dies before the effect ends, it transfers to the nearest enemy for %duration%.
While active, the effect cannot be reapplied to the same target.

206.name: Ancestors´ Amulet
206.description:
Dorian sacrifices a portion of his current Health to increase Max Health of the ally with the lowest Health until the end of the battle.

This skill only affects allies who started the battle with him.

207.name: Wings of Night
207.description: Attacks enemies and heals allies for %hits%% of the damage dealt.

208.name: Blood Seal
208.description:
Increases the Vampirism of nearby allies.
This skill only affects Heroes who started the battle with Dorian and remains active after his death.

The chance to increase Vampirism is lower if the allies’ level is higher than %level%.

209.name: Blood Pact
209.description:
Every %hits% seconds, deals damage to allies with Vampirism.
For %duration%, Vampirism restores more Health Points.
Dorian’s skills also heal allies more during this time.

210.name: Fountain of Blood
210.description: The effect now lasts %hits% seconds. Allies restore more HP when attacking.

211.name: Blood Seal
211.description: After being healed by Vampirism or Fountain of Blood, Dorian’s allies become immune to stun and sleep for %duration%.

212.name: Call of Blood
212.description:
When an ally dies, Dorian resurrects them at the cost of his own life. If allies restore Health through Vampirism multiple times, Dorian will be resurrected.

<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
When an ally dies, Dorian resurrects them, sacrificing himself.
After that, Dorian enters the “Near Death” state for %duration%. He cannot move, use skills, or be attacked.
If allies restore HP through Vampirism %hits% times during this period, Dorian is resurrected.

This skill only affects Heroes who started the battle with Dorian.

213.name: Phoenix's Fury
213.description:
Kayla throws a chakram, dealing damage to enemies around her. Hit enemies lose maximum health equal to %secondary%% of the damage dealt, and Kayla increases her maximum and current health by that value.
If Aidan in the allied team is dead, he gets resurrected with the same health value.

214.name: Acrobatics
214.description:
If Kayla's Health is above 40%, she jumps in the middle of the enemy team. If her Health drops below 25%, she heals for %duration%. Healing is increased for every allied Chaos Hero. Then she returns to the middle of her team when she can.
If Kayla's Health is below 25% when she activates this skill, she doesn't jump and starts healing instead.

215.name: Retaliatory Strike
215.description: Deals physical damage to enemies around Kayla based on the amount of damage she received since the last activation of this skill and blinds them for %duration%.

216.name: Inner Flame
216.description: After Kayla uses her second skill, she begins to burn, dealing pure damage to herself and enemies around her every 0.5 seconds. The effect ends when Kayla's Health drops below 25%.

217.name: Chaotic Fracture
217.description:
Reduces enemy Armor. When Kayla's Health is low, the effect is boosted.

<color=FFFDED>Full Description</color>
Reduces the Armor of all nearby enemies for %duration%. If Kayla's Health drops below half, their Armor is reduced even further.

218.name: Acrobatics
218.description: Kayla now deals damage to nearby enemies before leaping back to her allies.

219.name: Inner Flame
219.description:
The longer Kayla burns, the more damage the skill deals.

<color=FFFDED>Full Description</color>
While Kayla is burning, damage from the skill increases by %hits%% every %duration%

220.name: Frenzy
220.description:
Kayla's damage increases each time she loses a lot of Health.

<color=FFFDED>Full Description</color>
Each time Kayla cumulatively loses 50% of her initial Health, the damage she deals increases for the rest of the battle.

221.name: Wild Hunger
221.description: Swallows the current target for %duration%. While the target is swallowed, it slowly receives damage.

222.name: Burp
222.description: Hits a random target, damaging and slowing it for %duration%.

223.name: Fat Layer
223.description: Increases armor proportionally to missing health.

224.name: Bottomless Belly
224.description: Now %name% restores health by digesting the swallowed enemy.

225.name: Crystal of Selias
225.description: A light flash strikes at the center of the enemy team and deals damage to all enemies around the point of impact.

226.name: Crystalline Onslaught
226.description: Deals damage and stuns the closest target.

227.name: Piercing Light
227.description: Casts a spark of light which deals damage to all rivals in its way.

228.name: Rainbow Halo
228.description: A halo that absorbs part of the magic damage taken activates at the start of the battle. After absorbing damage equal to 10% of Aurora's health, the halo explodes, dealing the damage absorbed to nearby enemies. Reactivates after each explosion.

229.name: Predator Bite
229.description: Every %duration% attacks the nearest enemy and all shielded enemies.

230.name: Shieldbreaker
230.description: Now %hits%% of the skill’s damage is dealt to all shielded enemies.

231.name: Overwhelming
231.description: Now each hit of this skill additionally burns %hits% Energy from all shielded enemies.

232.name: Huntress' Fury
232.description:
Each time a shield is applied to an enemy, Oya’s current damage is increased by %duration%.

If a shield is applied to the entire team, the skill triggers once for each Hero that receives a shield.

233.name: Shifting Sands
233.description: %name% moves to the far line, uses his second skill (if available), and carries out ranged attacks for the next %duration%. The hero gets a physical attack bonus while the skill is active.

234.name: Mirage
234.description: %name% creates a sand clone nearby with a Health pool equal to a percentage of Hero's maximum Health. The clone can't restore Health or receive assistance from allies. The clone loses Health over time. If it doesn't receive damage from other sources, it'll persist for %duration%.

235.name: Perfect Blades
235.description: Sand clones get the ability to attack enemies. Clones that were created with the first skill continue attacking enemies from afar.

236.name: Many Truths
236.description: When using his second skill, %name% gets a chance to make two or four clones at once.

237.name: Roar of Nature
237.description:
Guardian Spirit deals Magic Damage to enemies, while Byrna and nearby allies restore Health.

<color=FFFDED>Full Description</color>
Guardian Spirit deals magic damage to enemies. Byrna and nearby allies restore Health equal to %hits%% of the damage dealt by the skill.

238.name: Guardian Punch
238.description:
Guardian Spirit attacks enemies, while each of Byrna's attacks restore Health and Energy to the ally with the lowest Health.

<color=FFFDED>Full Description</color>
Guardian Spirit moves across the battlefield, attacking enemies. It cannot be targeted and inherits Byrna’s Magic Attack and Magic Penetration.

Byrna’s basic attacks restore Health and Energy to the ally with the lowest Health.

239.name: Bear Cuddle
239.description:
Gradually heals the ally with the lowest Health and grants them Energy.

<color=FFFDED>Full Description</color>
Applies an effect to the ally with the lowest Health for %duration%.
Every %hits% seconds, that ally restores Health and gains Energy.

240.name: Living Heart
240.description: If an ally is fully healed, Byrna’s healing increases their Maximum Health.

241.name: Gift Spirit
241.description: Restores Energy every few seconds to the ally with the highest but not full Energy.

242.name: Bear Cuddle
242.description: When Bear Cuddle restores an ally’s Health, all negative effects are removed from them.

243.name: Living Heart
243.description: Now, if an ally is fully healed, any further healing from allies increases their Maximum Health.

244.name: Nature's Blessing
244.description: Increases the healing effectiveness of Byrna’s skills.

245.name: Ballad of Tenacity
245.description: %name% conjures a shield before his team, protecting allies from stun and curse effects. The shield loses health when opponents attack or use damage-dealing skills.

246.name: Hunter's Tune
246.description: Increases allies' critical hit chance for %duration%. Doesn't apply to heroes who don't have the stat.

247.name: Curse Song
247.description: At the start of the battle, %name% curses the nearest enemy, decreasing their armor. The curse is lifted on %name%'s death.

248.name: Rhythm of War
248.description: Critical hits by Sebastian and allies he started the battle with deal additional pure damage.

249.name: Rusty Hook
249.description:
Cleaver throws a hook at the farthest enemy, pulls them in, and deals pure damage.

Cleaver's basic attacks now deal pure damage.

250.name: Putrefaction
250.description: Deals pure damage to himself and nearby enemies every 0.5 sec. for %duration%.

251.name: Mutilation
251.description:
Strikes in front of himself, stunning nearby enemies for %duration% and dealing pure damage.

The chance to stun is reduced if the target's level is higher than %level%.

253.name: Pain’s Embrace
253.description:
Absorbs all incoming Damage. After activation, blinds enemies and increases allies' Magic Attack.

<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
Absorbs all incoming Damage for %duration%. While active, the Hero cannot attack, move, or be displaced.
When the effect ends, blinds nearby enemies for %hits% seconds and increases allies' Magic Attack.

254.name: Field of Lightning
254.description:
Reduces enemy Magic Defense with bursts of electricity.

<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
Strikes nearby enemies with lightning. Reduces their Magic Defense for %duration%. Magic Defense reduction increases by %hits% for every %secondary% Health lost at the moment of use.

255.name: Oath of Protection
255.description:
If allies have less Health than Electra, she absorbs the Damage they receive.

<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
For %duration%, applies an effect to all allies she started the battle with whose current Health is lower than hers. While the effect is active, absorbs part of the Damage they take.

Absorbs more Damage dealt to the Way of Eternity Heroes.

256.name: Immortal Shell
256.description:
At the start of battle, converts Armor, Magic Defense, and Dodge into Health.

<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
At the start of battle, converts Armor, Magic Defense, and Dodge into Health. The more points converted, the higher her maximum Health.

Armor, Magic Defense, and Dodge are permanently set to 0 and cannot be altered in combat.

257.name: Dance of Agony
257.description:
Periodically increases Attack Speed and Damage based on lost Health.

<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
Every 25 seconds, increases Attack Speed by %hits%% for %duration% and greatly boosts Damage based on Health lost at the time of the strike.

258.name: Pain’s Embrace
258.description: When the effect ends, deals Magic Damage equal to 50% of absorbed Damage.

259.name: Field of Lightning
259.description: If an enemy’s Magic Defense is reduced to zero, Electra and her allies deal 50% more Magic Damage to them.

260.name: Unbreakable Mind
260.description:
Becomes immune to control at low Health.

<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
When Health falls below %prime%%, gains immunity to all control effects.

261.name: Flame Veil
261.description: Casts a shield that blocks physical damage on the entire team. The shield's capacity is shared between all team members.

262.name: Devastation
262.description: %name% spews a flare of hellfire, burning up some of the energy accumulated by the furthest enemy.

263.name: Demon's Allegiance
263.description: Passive skill. %name% maintains a connection with the ally who has the least health left and takes on a part of the physical damage inflicted against that ally. The transferred damage is also reduced.

264.name: Last Word
264.description: Once per battle, %name% resurrects a fallen ally (or himself).

265.name: Purifier's Wrath
265.description: Tristan attacks nearby enemies, dealing physical damage.

266.name: Righteous Zeal
266.description: For %duration%, Tristan increases Physical Attack for himself and allies in front of him.

267.name: Judge of Sorcerers
267.description:
Tristan attacks the enemy with the highest Magic Penetration and burns part of their Energy.

<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
Tristan attacks the enemy with the highest Magic Penetration (or the farthest enemy if there are none). Each hit deals physical damage and burns part of the target's Energy.

This skill triggers once for each allied Way of Honor Hero.

268.name: Blessed Vanguard
268.description:
Whenever the ally in front of Tristan gains Energy, Tristan gains the same amount.

Tristan can gain bonus Energy only from Heroes who started the battle with him.

269.name: Sentence
269.description: Stuns nearby enemies and damages them.

270.name: Omen
270.description: %name% moves deep into the enemy team, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

271.name: Gehenna
271.description: Landing after using Omen, Luther creates a fiery wave that deals Physical Damage and stuns enemies around him for %duration%.

272.name: Doctrine of Faith
272.description:
Passive skill. Increases own Magic Defense.

Each time Luther takes Magic Damage, he increases his Magic Defense further for %duration%.

273.name: Rakashi's Barrier
273.description: %name% creates a shield over his team that absorbs magic damage and pure damage. Shield strength increases by %hits%% for every allied Mystery Hero other than Rufus.

274.name: Rakashi's Mockery
274.description: Deals damage over time to the enemy with the highest Magic Attack and Silences them for %duration%.

275.name: Devourer of Magic
275.description: Part of the damage absorbed by Rakashi's Barrier heals Rufus and his allies.

276.name: Rakashi's Oath
276.description: Now %name% can only be killed by physical damage. If the last strike that hit Rufus dealt magic or pure damage, he will be resurrected and have a portion of his Health restored. This effect triggers for as long as any allies Rufus started the battle with still stand.

277.name: Iron Skies
277.description: %name% brings down swords of justice on the enemies' heads.

278.name: Unstoppable Charge
278.description: Dashes forward, removing control effects and dealing damage to enemies nearby.

279.name: Retaliation
279.description: Performs a special move, striking the enemy with the lowest health.

280.name: Harun's Pride
280.description: The Iron Skies skill now deals additional pure damage.

281.name: Focus of Hatred
281.description: %name% temporarily increases her armor and magic defense and taunts the enemy team, forcing them to attack her for %duration%.

282.name: Reflection of Pain
282.description: %name% activates an ancient curse. The curse reflects %prime%% of physical damage received by %name% back at the attacker for %duration%.

283.name: Shelter of Sands
283.description: If %name%'s health is below %secondary%% (but only once every %cooldown%), she burrows into the ground for %duration%, avoiding enemy attacks and restoring health.

284.name: Fury of Akhreb Ummi
284.description: Now, when %name% unburies herself, she stuns and throws back any nearby enemies and uses the second skill.

285.name: Instrument of Fate
285.description: %name% throws %hits% spectral spears at multiple enemies, dealing physical damage and pushing the targets back.

287.name: Retribution
287.description: When %name% or an ally dodges damage, %name% conjures a spectral spear and throws it at the nearest enemy. The spear deals physical damage and pushes its target back.

288.name: Shackles of Weakness
288.description: When a spectral spear from Instrument of Fate or Retribution hits an enemy, %name% decreases the target's main stat for %duration%.

289.name: Piercing Throw
289.description: Every %duration%, throws a spectral spear that deals damage to the nearest enemy and knocks them back.

290.name: Instrument of Fate
290.description: Whenever Dante knocks an enemy back, he gains a bonus to armor penetration for %duration%.

291.name: Shackles of Weakness
291.description: Now reduces the target's main stat for %param_UpgradedDuration% seconds.

292.name: Shifting Focus
292.description: Dante's Dodge increases if there are enemies nearby. If there are no enemies nearby, his Physical attack increases. Bonuses depend on the Physical attack at the start of the battle.

293.name: Blade Whirlwind
293.description: %name% launches a whirlwind of blades. The blades reach the furthest enemy and then return, dealing damage to enemies as they fly and silencing them for %duration% on their way back.

295.name: Dancing Blades
295.description: Passive skill. Keira's basic attack can ricochet between enemies. The ricocheting blade deals %prime%% of basic attack damage on each hit.

296.name: Piercing Pain
296.description: Passive skill. If the enemy's armor is lower than Keira's armor penetration, her basic attack deals extra damage.

297.name: Go for it, Lucas!
297.description: Lucas gets 25% rage at the start of the battle and gets 25% more with each of Astrid's attacks. At 100% rage, Astrid can activate the skill to transform Lucas into his raging form. Lucas moves to the front line to attack enemies and takes their hits, losing 7% rage with each hit instead of taking damage. When the rage meter empties, Lucas returns to his passive form.

298.name: Rampant Nature
298.description: Astrid increases her attack and skill speed by %duration%. If her pet is in rage form, the attack speed bonus affects it instead of Astrid. The pet also gets this buff when transforming to rage form.

299.name: Predator's Charge
299.description: Passive skill. As long as Astrid's pet is in rage form, each consecutive attack deals increasing damage.

300.name: Tracker's Mark
300.description: Passive skill. Each of the hero's attacks marks the enemy hit with the Tracker's Mark for 4 seconds. If the pet hits a marked enemy, the enemy is stunned for a short period.

301.name: Qing Long
301.description: Summons a dragon spirit that launches 3 attacks against nearby enemies. Each strike sets them on fire for %duration%, pushes them back, and deals damage.

302.name: Spear of Dawn
302.description: Blinds the nearest enemies and damages them.

303.name: Dragon´s Claw
303.description: Deals damage to the nearest enemy based on their current health

304.name: Open Heart
304.description:
Each Qing Mao's strike that deals physical damage steals Armor from the target and extra Armor for every allied Honor Hero.
The effect lasts for the duration of the battle or until Qing Mao dies. Qing Mao can't steal more Armor than the target has in total.

305.name: Icy Vengeance
305.description: Damages enemies with %hits% ice crystals in succession. Each crystal does area damage and slows the opponents it hits by 30% for %duration%.

306.name: Chains of Frost
306.description: %name% hits the enemies in the center of an enemy's team, temporarily reducing their magic defense and applying a Mark of Water to them.

307.name: Frozen Needles
307.description: Freezes the ground under the feet of an enemy's team, filling the zone with ice thorns. Any movement through the area deals damage to enemies. When the thorns melt, all heroes standing on them get a Mark of Water.

308.name: Crystallization
308.description:
When in danger of receiving major damage, Krista freezes herself into a chunk of ice that blocks a portion of all incoming damage for %duration%.
If Krista is damaged while encased in ice, she gets bonus energy.

309.name: Torment of Powerlessness
309.description: %name% summons a Skull to the enemy's front line which deals magic damage to nearby heroes. Affected enemies cannot gain energy for %duration%.

310.name: Cycle of Energies
310.description: Protects an ally with a magic shield. The ally will gain energy at a doubled rate until the shield is destroyed.

311.name: Leper
311.description: %name% curses everyone on the enemy team, making the furthest enemy the target of the curse. Physical damage taken by heroes on the enemy team will be redirected to the target of the curse for %duration%.

312.name: Tainted Wounds
312.description: With every attack Jorgen steals some of the affected enemy's energy.

313.name: Deadly Ray
313.description:
Xe'Sha drains %prime%% from the max health of any allies with over 25% of their health currently remaining, then attacks the enemy with the lowest magic defense. The damage dealt depends on the damage dealt to allies and Xe'Sha's magic attack. If the target is killed as a result, allies recover double the health they lost.
Xe'Sha's basic attacks deal magic damage and scale with Magic Attack.

314.name: Spiritual Power
314.description: Xe'Sha fills her allies with power, damaging them by %secondary%% of their max health if their current health is above 25%. The empowered heroes gain a magic attack bonus for %duration%. The bonus is doubled for Chaos Heroes.

315.name: Crimson Mist
315.description: Xe'Sha shrouds the battlefield in mist for %duration%, causing enemy basic attacks to miss.

316.name: Soaring Might
316.description: Whenever an ally loses health from allied skills, Xe'Sha gains a permanent magic attack bonus of %prime%% of the health lost by the ally.

317.name: Fetters of the Wind
317.description: Launches a hurricane that knocks up every target hit and deals damage to them.

318.name: Breath of the Abyss
318.description: Creates a fiery pillar at the center of the enemy team, dealing damage to enemies.

319.name: Explosive Sphere
319.description:
Throws a fire orb at the enemy with the lowest Magic Defense. It deals damage and then explodes.

<color=FFFDED>Full Description</color>
Throws a fire orb at the enemy with the lowest Magic Defense. It first deals damage over %duration% then explodes, damaging nearby enemies.

321.name: Living Bomb
321.description:
Every few seconds, applies the Living Bomb effect to an enemy. When they die, they deal damage to all other enemies.

<color=FFFDED>Full Description</color>
Every 15 seconds, the Living Bomb effect is applied to an enemy. Upon death, they deal damage to all other enemies.

If the effect is already present on the target, it is applied to the next enemy instead.

322.name: Breath of the Abyss
322.description:
Creates a second fiery pillar in the center of the enemy team.

<color=FFFDED>Full Description</color>
Creates a second fiery pillar at the same location as the first. It inflicts less damage in a smaller radius.

323.name: Explosive Sphere
323.description: While the fire orb is active, the Living Bomb effect is applied to the target. Upon death, they deal damage to all other enemies.

324.name: Bloody Boost
324.description:
Each time health is restored through vampirism, the Hero’s primary stat increases.

<color=FFFDED>Full Description</color>
Each time Kai or one of his allies restores health using vampirism, their primary stats increase for %duration%. The effect stacks up to 3 times.

325.name: Lord of the Storm
325.description:
%name% summons a hurricane in the back of the enemy team that pulls Heroes into its center and applies the Mark of Water to them.
Hurricane damages enemies twice: at the moment of its summoning and at the moment of its disappearance.

326.name: Chain Lightning
326.description: Launches an electrical charge hitting each enemy one by one.

327.name: Lightning Bolt
327.description: Strikes the nearest enemy with a lightning bolt, dealing damage and stunning them for %duration%. Enemies with a Mark of Water are prioritized.

328.name: Conductance
328.description: All of Lars' attacks against enemies with a Mark of Water deal more damage and stun them for a longer period of time.

329.name: Masquerade
329.description: A magic strike stuns, blinds, or slows each rival down for %duration%.

330.name: Boldness
330.description: Casts a shield sphere on an ally for %duration%. Whenever an enemy tries to damage the shielded ally, the sphere damages nearby opponents instead.

331.name: Frolic
331.description: Blasts the nearest opponent with magic, stunning them for %duration% and dealing damage.

332.name: Trickster
332.description: Frolic gains a chance to deal double or quadruple damage

333.name: Heavy Wisdom
333.description: Hits the enemy with the highest Intelligence with a monolith, dealing damage proportionally to their Intelligence.

334.name: Rune of Suppression
334.description: An ancient spell which hits the enemy with the highest Magic Attack and reduces their Magic Attack for the next %duration%.

335.name: Protective Dome
335.description: %name% casts a barrier on the team, increasing their Magic Defense for %duration%.

336.name: Memory Loss
336.description: %name% curses a random enemy at the beginning of the battle, reducing the level of their first skill. If %name% dies, the curse will disappear.

337.name: Astral Projection
337.description:
Launches a projectile that deals damage to enemies within its area of effect and burns their Energy upon activation.

<color=FFFDED>Full Description</color>
Launches a projectile that deals damage to enemies within its area of effect and burns their Energy upon activation. The damage and Energy burn are divided equally among all affected enemies. If not activated manually, the projectile explodes automatically upon reaching the farthest enemy.

338.name: Serenity
338.description:
Restores Health to the two nearest allies and removes negative effects from them.

If there is only one nearby ally, Nebula applies this skill to that ally and herself.

339.name: Disharmony
339.description:
Speeds up herself and allies behind her while protecting them from Damage Over Time.

<color=FFFDED>Full Description</color>
Increases Movement Speed and Skill Recharge Speed of herself and allies behind her by %hits%% for %duration%, and blocks incoming Damage Over Time.

340.name: Equilibrium
340.description:
Nebula's basic attacks now switch to Support mode. Whenever this skill triggers, it increases Physical and Magic Attack of one nearby ally for %duration%.

If there is only one nearby ally, Nebula alternates this skill between that ally and herself.

341.name: Two Fates
341.description:
Celeste spends 50% of her energy and switches to her ^{183 219 244}^Light Form^{/color}^. When the skill is used again, she switches back to her ^{135 22 218}^Dark Form^{/color}^. 

When switching to ^{135 22 218}^Dark Form^{/color}^, Celeste creates a large area of ^{135 22 218}^Cursed Flame^{/color}^ in the center of the enemy team. Enemies affected by the ^{135 22 218}^Cursed Flame^{/color}^ can't be healed. 

When switching to ^{183 219 244}^Light Form^{/color}^, Celeste directs a large ^{183 219 244}^Purifying Sphere^{/color}^ at the ally with the least health left. The ^{183 219 244}^Purifying Sphere^{/color}^ restores the ally's health for %duration%.

342.name: White Night
342.description:
In her ^{135 22 218}^Dark Form^{/color}^, Celeste occasionally surrounds the nearest enemy with a small area of ^{135 22 218}^Cursed Flame^{/color}^. 
In her ^{183 219 244}^Light Form^{/color}^, Celeste directs a ^{183 219 244}^Purifying Sphere^{/color}^ at the ally with the least health left.

343.name: Limbo
343.description: Healing blocked by the ^{135 22 218}^Cursed Flame^{/color}^ is converted into magic damage dealt to the same target. The ^{183 219 244}^Purifying Sphere^{/color}^ clears and blocks all the negative effects afflicting the ally before it disappears.

344.name: Zenith
344.description: Celeste's ^{135 22 218}^basic attacks^{/color}^ now deal magic damage while she's in her Dark Form, and target her allies with healing while she's in her ^{183 219 244}^Light Form^{/color}^.

345.name: Curse of the Ancient God
345.description:
For %duration%, casts the Curse of the Ancient God on the nearest enemy, stealing Armor and Magic Defense from them and dealing damage. The Armor and Magic Defense stolen from the enemy are evenly distributed among all allies for %duration%.
Cannot steal more Armor and Magic Defense than the enemy possesses.
This ability only affects Heroes with whom Soleil started the battle.

346.name: Halo
346.description:
Envelops the frontmost ally in a magical halo for %duration%, reducing the damage they take. If an enemy's attack completely penetrates the Armor of the haloed ally, the damage is reduced further.
