The ally with the halo cannot be stunned, blinded, or silenced. If an enemy tries to stun, blind, or silence the haloed ally, the effect will rebound onto the enemy themselves for 3 seconds.

347.name: Mark of the Ancient God
347.description:
Applies the Mark of the Ancient God to the central enemy for %duration%. The enemy takes damage with each use of their abilities and takes additional damage when enemy Heroes use control abilities.
This ability only affects Heroes with whom Soleil started the battle.

348.name: Blessing of the Ancient God
348.description:
For %duration%, increases damage from physical and magical attacks, as well as healing, for all allies in front of the Hero.
Additionally increases damage and healing for each control ability used by enemies since the beginning of the battle.

349.name: Total Destruction
349.description: Fires %hits% magic missiles at the enemies with the highest health.

350.name: Magnetic Field
350.description: Creates an explosion in the enemy back line, dealing area damage and slowing enemies down for %duration%.

351.name: Antimatter Blast
351.description: Launches a projectile at the closest enemy, stunning them for %duration% and dealing magic damage.

352.name: Full Charge
352.description: Passive skill. %name% receives additional energy with each attack.

353.name: Star Birth
353.description:
%name% directs %hits% new and all existing Solar Spheres to the frontline of the enemy team, where they explode, dealing damage in an area of effect.
By summoning any sphere, Helios heals allied Honor Heroes for %secondary%% Health.

354.name: Solar Wind
354.description:
Summons an invulnerable flaming sphere, dealing damage to nearby enemies over time for 10 sec.
The sphere deals %secondary%% more damage for each allied Honor Hero other than Helios.

355.name: Celestial Guardians
355.description: Summons %hits% protection spheres at the center of your team. The spheres protect nearby allies by absorbing physical damage dealt to them.

356.name: Flaming Retribution
356.description: While Solar Wind is active, every time Helios' allies suffer a critical hit, the flaming sphere will strike the damaging attacker with a beam of fire.

357.name: Distortion of Fate
357.description: Summons a huge mirror behind allies for %duration%. While the mirror exists, the damage of each hit dodged by an ally is reflected back at the enemy.

358.name: Favorite of the Empress
358.description:
Octavia applies a buff to furthest forward ally that she started the battle with, increasing their Dodge for %duration%.
Eternity Heroes receive a stronger buff.
Passive effect: Octavia's allies have a chance to dodge even magic damage.

359.name: Moment of Concentration
359.description:
Applies a buff to all allies, increasing their Armor Penetration for %duration%.
The same buff is also applied to an ally every time that they dodge any damage.

360.name: Imperial Guard
360.description:
Cannot be the target of skills and attacks, so long as the allies that Octavia started the battle with, are alive.
When allies dodge any damage, both the Guard and Octavia get extra energy.

361.name: Lightning Strike
361.description:
Blinds Heroes in the center of the battlefield and deals damage to enemies.

<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
Creates a flash that Blinds all Heroes in the center of the battlefield for %duration%, and deals damage to enemies.

While affected by any Blindness, allies always hit enemies, and their attacks cannot be evaded.
Miu is always Blinded.

362.name: Veil of Insight
362.description:
Blinds the ally in front of her for %duration%.

Any Blindness affecting allies increases their Magical Crit Hit chance.

363.name: Blind Fury
363.description:
Deals Magical damage to the central enemy and surrounding enemies.

Blinded enemies take increased damage.

364.name: Gift of the Storm
364.description:
Each time Miu or her allies land a Critical Hit, their Magic Penetration is increased for %duration%.

This skill triggers once every %param_buffCD% seconds.

365.name: Blinding Stormcloud
365.description:
Every %hits% seconds, blinds the nearest non-Blinded enemy for %duration%.

If all enemies are Blinded, the central enemy takes damage.

366.name: Lightning Strike
366.description: Blindness now affects the entire battlefield.

367.name: Veil of Insight
367.description: Magical Critical Hits from blinded allies now deal more damage.

368.name: Eternal Blindness
368.description: The duration of all Blindness effects is increased by %duration%.

370.name: Secret of Longevity
370.description: Martha's basic attacks heal her when a projectile hits an enemy. The farther the projectile travels, the more health it will restore.

371.name: Tea Party
371.description: Conjures a totem in front of the character that restores allies' health. Enemies can't target the totem, but it can take AoE damage.

372.name: Healing Brew
372.description: While the totem is active, the ally with the least health now recieves additional healing.

373.name: Blacksmith Mastery
373.description:
Stuns all enemies for %duration%. 
If Fafnir was forging a Runic Shield for an ally when cast, all allies receive the Shield’s effect.
Also casts a Runic Blade effect at the current level on all allies.
The ability only affects Heroes that Fafnir started the battle alongside.

374.name: Runic Shield
374.description:
Fafnir targets a random ally and begins using his basic attacks to forge a Runic Shield for them, increasing its durability with each hit.
The shield activates if the target hero takes damage that lowers their health to below 25%. The hero cannot die from taking that damage. The shield absorbs any damage when active.
Heroes with the Agility main stat are prioritized when selecting a target.

375.name: Runic Blade
375.description:
Fafnir enchants the weapon of the ally he's forging a Runic Shield for, increasing their physical attack damage for %duration%. 
While allied Honor Heroes attack enemies with the Strength main stat, their bonus from this skill is doubled.

376.name: Knowledge of Flaws
376.description:
Allied attacks that pierce armor completely stun enemies for %duration%. 
The stun on each enemy can be triggered once every %cooldown%.

377.name: Lead Storm
377.description: Quickly fires %hits% buckshot rounds from the pistol, damaging all enemies.

378.name: Penetrating Shot
378.description: Launches a projectile that knocks back an enemy and hits a target behind their back. All knocked-back enemies get concussed for %duration%: their movement speed drops significantly.

379.name: Suppressive Fire
379.description: Shoots in the air, damaging the whole enemy team with buckshot.

380.name: Ranging Shot
380.description: Progress Heroes on Ginger’s team get a physical attack bonus with each of her basic attacks.The bonus cap is calculated at the beginning of a battle, and is reached within %hits% attacks.

381.name: Solar Sanctuary
381.description: Heals all members of the team.

382.name: Healing Beam
382.description: Heals the ally with the lowest health.

383.name: Vow of Silence
383.description: Places magical marks above enemies, silencing them for %duration%.

384.name: Second Wind
384.description: When healing an ally with the first or second ability, %name% increases their skill speed for %duration%.

385.name: Elixir of Vigor
385.description: %name% channels the flow of life-giving elixir to the ally with the greatest Physical attack and starts slowly spending energy. Until the energy runs out or %name% gets interrupted, that ally receives increased Physical attack, a 30% bonus to speed, and a Health regen effect.

386.name: Acid Shot
386.description: %name% shoots acid at the enemy with the highest Armor, decreasing their Armor for %duration%

387.name: Potion of Fatigue
387.description: %name% launches a poisoned potion flask at the closest enemies. Affected enemies cannot regenerate Health for %duration%

388.name: Inordinate Fury
388.description: While %name% is alive, all his allies have an increased critical hit chance.

389.name: Underworld Seal
389.description: Applies a demonic seal to the central enemy. The seal explodes, damaging the target and nearby enemies. Lilith grows in size, increasing her max and current health by %secondary%% for each enemy damaged and for each allied Chaos Hero.

390.name: Demonic Fury
390.description: Lilith lashes out in demonic fury for %duration%, attacking twice with each basic attack. Her attacks also target the central enemy and deal extra magic damage in an area of effect.

391.name: Fire Breath
391.description: Lilith breathes fire onto the central enemy, reducing the target and nearby enemies' magic defense by %duration%.

392.name: Sacrifice
392.description: While Lilith's Health is above 25%, she sacrifices %prime%% of maximum Health before using a skill and increases her Magic Attack based on the amount of sacrificed Health for %duration%.

393.name: Theater of Pain
393.description:
Strikes the nearest enemy %hits% times. Each strike deals physical area damage and slightly pushes back affected enemies.
Passive: %name% increases the range of her basic attacks and the area of effect of her basic attacks and first skill by %secondary%% for each Chaos ally the Hero starts the battle with.

394.name: Harlequin's Punishment
394.description:
Deals physical damage to the enemy with the highest Armor. Then, for %duration%, reduces the target's Armor and increases the Physical or Magic attack of all allies whose Intelligence exceeds that of the target by a percentage of the target's current Armor.
Allies gain a boost to the stat that was higher at the start of the battle.

395.name: The Final Act
395.description:
Links herself to the enemy with the highest Physical attack for %duration%. The target is unable to move, and %name% steals a portion of their Physical attack every 0.5 seconds. %name% retains the stolen Physical attack for %duration% after the effect ends or is interrupted.
This ability does not prevent Heroes from fighting but is interrupted if %name% is subjected to a control effect.

396.name: Stage Presence
396.description:
Passive skill. Each ally positioned in front of %name% at the moment of the attack increases all damage the Hero deals. The bonus is greater if an ally belongs to the Chaos faction. 
Only the allies that %name% started the battle with are counted.

397.name: Lava Kiss
397.description:
Attacks the enemy with the lowest Health, sacrificing her own health points to deal additional damage.
 
<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
Attacks the enemy with the lowest Health, dealing magic damage. While Kendle's Health is above %param_porog%%, she deals pure damage to the target every second, sacrificing %hits%% of her own health points.
 
The skill ends when the target dies.

398.name: Sweet Torture
398.description: Increases Magical crit hit chance for herself and all allies who have taken damage from their own or allied skills since the last use of this skill.

399.name: Friendly Fire
399.description:
Ignites the ally with the highest percentage of max Health. The ally loses health points, and Kendle deals pure damage to their target.
 
<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
Ignites the ally with the highest percentage of max Health, causing them to lose %hits%% of their health points per second. Whenever the burning ally attacks an enemy, Kendle deals pure damage to their target.
The effect ends when the ally's health points drop below %param_param_porog%%.
 
This skill cannot be applied to already burning hero.

400.name: Purge by Pain
400.description:
If Kendle has more than %param_porog%% health points, her basic attacks consume %hits%% of her Health and deal pure damage.
 
Her pure damage can now become critical. The chance depends on her Magical crit hit chance.

401.name: Agony Surge
401.description:
Kendle damages herself every %duration% and either attacks an enemy or heals herself.
 
<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
If Kendle has more than %param_porog%% health points, every %duration% she deals %hits%% damage to herself and attacks a ranged enemy with pure damage.
 
If she has less than %param_porog%% health points, every %duration% she restores %hits%% Health.

402.name: Lava Kiss
402.description: Before activating the skill, restores %param_porog%% of her health points and increases her Magical crit hit chance.

403.name: Purge by Pain
403.description: Allies' pure damage can now become critical. The chance depends on Magical crit hit chance.

404.name: Reaping Hour
404.description: For %duration%, increases her pure damage each time allies take damage from their own or allied skills.

405.name: Searing Claws
405.description: Every %duration%, deals magic damage to all enemies with Fox Fire marks without removing them. If no enemies have marks, applies %hits% marks to each enemy.

406.name: Ravenous Pack
406.description: Now, upon activating Ravenous Pack, Satori removes all negative effects from himself and becomes immune to them while the skill is active.

407.name: Spirit Banishment
407.description: Spirit Banishment now applies %hits% additional marks.

408.name: Cunning Fox
408.description: Enemies with %hits% or more Fox Fire marks deal less damage to Satori.

409.name: Frozen Maelstrom
409.description: Gains Nova’s Accuracy. Every %duration%, launches a projectile at the back rows of enemies, dealing damage and stunning them for %hits% sec.

410.name: Tidal Wave
410.description: Gains Hyperion’s Power. The farther enemies are from Cascade, the more damage Tidal Wave deals to them.

411.name: Refluence
411.description: Gains Mairi’s cunning. The Sodden Armor effect now also reduces enemies’ Physical attack.

412.name: Iceberg Shard
412.description: Gains Sigurd’s endurance. Upon activating the first ability, Cascade becomes immune to all damage for %duration%.

413.name: Silent Judgment
413.description: Attacks enemies in the front, applying Silence for %duration% to all enemies whose main stat is Intelligence.

414.name: Holy Grenade
414.description:
Throws a grenade at the enemy with the highest Intelligence, applying Silence and dealing area damage.

<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
Throws a grenade at the enemy with the highest Intelligence, applying Silence for %duration%.
The target and nearby enemies take damage.

415.name: Swift Retribution
415.description:
Crow speeds up the cooldown of his skills, and his basic attacks deal an additional hit to enemies under Silence.

<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
For %duration%, the Hero's skills recharge %hits%% faster, and his basic attacks deal an additional hit to all enemies affected by Silence.

416.name: Final Verdict
416.description:
When Crow reapplies Silence, the enemy takes damage and the effect's duration is increased.

<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
When Crow applies Silence to an enemy that already has the same active effect, the enemy takes damage.
The effect's duration is increased by the duration of the longest Silence already affecting the enemy.

417.name: Witch Hunt
417.description:
Attacks the enemy with the highest Intelligence and spreads Silence to nearby enemies.

<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
Every %duration%, attacks the enemy with the highest Intelligence.
If the target is Silenced, spreads the effect to all nearby enemies for the remaining duration.
Otherwise, applies Silence for %hits% seconds.

418.name: Silent Judgment
418.description: Now applies Silence to all enemies for %duration%.

419.name: Holy Grenade
419.description: Grenade shards deal damage to all Silenced enemies and enemies around them. Silence duration is increased by %hits% sec. for all affected targets.

420.name: Confinement
420.description:
While at least one enemy is Silenced, enemies cannot apply Debuffs or Curses.

Skill remains active while Crow is alive.

421.name: Seal of Retribution
421.description:
Periodically applies Silence to the enemy with the highest Magic Penetration and enemies around them, dealing damage.

<color=FFFDED>Full description</color>
Every %hits% seconds, Tristan applies Silence for %duration% to the enemy with the highest Magic Penetration (or the farthest enemy if there are none) and nearby enemies.
Heroes affected by the skill also take physical damage.

422.name: Purifier's Wrath
422.description: The skill now applies Silence to nearby enemies for %duration% and deals increased damage.

423.name: Blessed Vanguard
423.description: Allies whose Physical Attack is higher than their Magic Attack at the start of battle now gain %secondary%% of the Energy Tristan receives from this skill.

424.name: Sinners' Payback
424.description: When Tristan or his allies penetrate target's Armor, their opponent receives additional 200% damage of the amount that their Armor Penetration exceeded enemy's Armor.

425.name: Miasma
425.description:
Applies an effect to the central enemy for %duration%, dealing damage to all enemies around them every %param_dotTickTime% sec.

If Putrefaction is upgraded, enemies are also afflicted with an effect that reduces their healing.

426.name: Putrefaction
426.description:
Enemies within this skill's area of effect or those affected by Miasma restore %secondary%% less health points to themselves and their allies.

If an enemy is affected by both effects, the healing reduction is doubled.

427.name: Heavyweight
427.description:
Whenever Cleaver or his allies take damage from their own or allied skills, all negative effects are removed from the damaged hero.

This skill remains active while Cleaver is alive.

428.name: Carnage
428.description: Cleaver now deals more damage for each enemy around him.

429.name: Tragic Finale
429.description:
Deals physical damage over time to enemies weakened by the Harlequin's Punishment skill.

<color=FFFDED>Full Description</color>
Every %hits% sec., applies the Tragic Finale effect to enemies weakened by the Harlequin's Punishment skill. For %duration%, the effect deals physical damage over time.

If there are no such enemies, the effect is applied to the center enemy.

430.name: Harlequin's Punishment
430.description:
The skill now affects two enemies and increases allies' Physical or Magic Attack for each enemy weakened by the Harlequin's Punishment skill. The bonuses stack.

Targets are prioritized by descending Armor.

431.name: The Final Act
431.description:
The skill now affects two enemies.

Targets are prioritized by descending Physical Attack.

432.name: Show Must Go On
432.description: Any damage Peech deals to enemies, except for damage over time, now has a %hits%% chance to apply the Tragic Finale effect to the target.

433.name: Impossible Shot
433.description: Aims for %param_realAnimationDelay% sec., then fires at the nearest enemy, dealing physical damage plus extra physical damage equal to %hits%% of the target's Max Health.

434.name: Focusing Scope
434.description:
Attacks the farthest enemy and applies Marked effect to them for %duration%.

While Marked effect is active, the target additionally takes a portion of the damage dealt by allied Marksmen to other Heroes.

435.name: Piercing Shot
435.description: Aims and fires at all enemies in front of her.

436.name: Marksmen Unity
436.description: Increases the damage dealt by Eva and all allied Marksmen. The bonus scales with the distance to the target and can reach up to %hits%% of the original damage.

437.name: Antivirus
437.description: Every %hits% sec., Eva gains an effect that removes all control effects, and prevents new control effects from being applied for %duration%.

438.name: Impossible Shot
438.description: Now deals more extra physical damage equal to %param_patronHPPercentDamage%% of the target's Max Health.

439.name: Piercing Shot
439.description: Now restores %hits% Energy for each enemy hit by this skill.

440.name: Explosive Payload
440.description:
Whenever Eva deals damage to a target, it is increased by a percentage of the target's Max Health.

Does not affect damage over time or shared damage.

441.name: Power of Balance
441.description:
Every %hits% sec., increases the Main Stat of the nearest allies for %duration%. If there are no nearby allies, Nebula buffs herself.

Only affects allies who started the battle with Nebula.

442.name: Serenity
442.description: Heals herself and all allies, removing negative effects from them.

443.name: Equilibrium
443.description:
Increases both Physical and Magic Attack of the two nearest allies simultaneously.

If there is only one nearby ally, Nebula applies this skill to that ally and herself.

444.name: Deep Meditation
444.description: The duration of all buffs applied by Nebula and her allies, as well as the effects of their first Artifacts, is increased by %duration%.

445.name: Pawsitive Influence
445.description: Every %duration%, grants the most injured ally a Shield that absorbs any damage. The more Health points the ally has lost, the stronger the Shield.

446.name: Meowsterpiece of Defense
446.description:
Now, when a Shield is destroyed or expires, the Hero protected by it recovers Health points. Does not apply to the Meowsterpiece of Defense skill.

Way of Progress Heroes receive twice as much healing.

447.name: Nine-Lives Engine
447.description: Now, whenever Julius or an ally gains a Shield, all negative effects are removed from that Hero.

448.name: Defensive Lunge
448.description: While Julius or his allies have a Shield, their Armor Penetration is increased for each active Shield.

449.name: Righteous Retribution
449.description:
Every %hits% sec., Luther starts accumulating Righteousness. All incoming damage charges it for %duration%.

When the timer expires or when Luther dies, he deals Physical Damage equal to accumulated charge to enemies around him.

450.name: Gehenna
450.description: Now, the skill triggers every %hits% sec.

451.name: Doctrine of Faith
451.description: Now, when taking Magic Damage, Luther also increases his Armor Penetration for %duration%.

452.name: Unshakable Faith
452.description: While Luther is alive, all enemies around him have their Magic Attack decreased.

453.name: Featherhood
453.description: Every %duration%, grants a Golden Feather to himself and the ally with the highest Health stat.

454.name: Beak Peak
454.description:
Healing from Guus's skills can be critical, restoring more health points.

The Critical Healing chance depends on his Critical Hit Chance.

455.name: Honkageddon
455.description: Now, when Guus deals critical damage, he additionally restores health points and grants a Golden Feather to nearby allies.

456.name: No Honk, No Gain
456.description: While Guus and his allies are affected by a Golden Feather, they take less magic and pure critical damage.

457.name: Crown of Wrath
457.description: Casts a Crown above the enemy team, dealing damage every second to all enemies underneath it for %duration%. This attack always hits enemies, and it cannot be evaded.

458.name: Bark Renewal
458.description:
Clears all Debuffs and Control effects from himself and the allies behind him, then heals himself.

Wodryn gains 1 layer of Oak Bark for each effect removed, but at least %hits% layers. While Oak Bark is active, Wodryn gains extra Energy each time he takes damage.

459.name: Deepwood Might
459.description:
Removes %hits% layers of Oak Bark from himself and increases Crit hit chance of the allies behind him for %duration%.

Passive effect. For each Oak Bark layer removed, Wodryn's Crit hit chance increases until the end of the battle.

460.name: Unbowed Oak
460.description: Wodryn and the allies behind him have a chance to take reduced damage. The chance depends on each Hero's Critical hit chance.

461.name: Wildwood Fury
461.description:
For %duration%, critical hits of Wodryn and his allies deal extra physical damage every %hits% seconds.

The extra damage depends on each Hero's Magic defense.

462.name: Bark Renewal
462.description:
While Oak Bark is active, Wodryn deals damage to enemies in front of him after every %param_patronParam% hits he takes.

The hit counter resets when Oak Bark expires.

463.name: Unbowed Oak
463.description: Whenever Wodryn's incoming damage is reduced by Unbowed Oak, he gains %hits% layers of Oak Bark.

464.name: Law of the Forest
464.description: As long as Wodryn is alive, all pure damage dealt by enemies to his team is converted into magic damage.

465.name: Voracious Spores
465.description: %hits% seconds after the battle starts, and every %duration% thereafter, deals damage to the enemy with the highest Max Health. Additionally, steals Max Health from the target equal to %secondary%% of the damage dealt.

466.name: Perfect Copy
466.description: When activated, Shrooms get the Relic and start using the Voracious Spores skill after %hits% seconds.

467.name: Wild Growth
467.description:
Whenever they receive healing, Mushy and active Shrooms increase their Magic Penetration for %duration%.
The effect stacks for every active Shroom on the battlefield.

468.name: Mycelial Echo
468.description:
Whenever an enemy receives healing, Mushy and all Shrooms (including inactive ones) restore Health equal to %prime%% of the amount healed.

This skill won't trigger if the enemy's healing is triggered by a similar effect.

1.name: Frost Needles
1.description: Launches an ice wave that gradually becomes more powerful at the enemy's back line. Enemies next to the farthest one receive the highest damage. Nearby enemies receive reduced damage.

2.name: Frigid Healing
2.description: Heals the ally with the lowest Health.

3.name: Icy Aegis
3.description: Lifts the shield and becomes immune to any damage for %duration%.

4.name: North Wind
4.description: Launches a projectile at the enemy's back line, dealing damage and stunning affected targets for %duration%.

5.name: Abyss Curse
5.description: Decreases the Attack of all enemies by %prime%% for %duration%.

6.name: Child of Water
6.description:
For %duration%, summons the Child of Water in front of the allied team. It does not move or attack. Once per second, the Child steals Health from the enemy that has the most of it and transfers to the ally who has the least.
Child of Water is a Water Titan and can’t be attacked.

7.name: Deep Current
7.description:
Passive. Empowers allied Water Titans. Bonuses stack and depend on the number of Water Titans that remain alive on the battlefield.
2 — Extra Damage against Fire Titans.
3 — Extra Defense against Fire Titans.
4 — %name% receives +400 Energy when using skills.
5 — When using the first skill, all allied Water Titans restore Health and cleanse all negative effects that were applied to them.
6 — Reduces incoming damage by 50%.

8.name: Incinerating Ray
8.description: For %duration%, %name% breathes out flame towards the nearest enemy, dealing damage per second.

10.name: Crushing Blow
10.description: Stuns nearby enemies for %duration% with a powerful strike, dealing damage.

12.name: Child of Flame
12.description:
Summons Child of Flame for %duration% over the center of the enemy team. It doesn’t move but burns opponents around it, dealing damage every 2 seconds.
Child of Flame is a Fire Titan and cannot be attacked.

13.name: Blazing Blessing
13.description:
Passive. Empowers allied Fire Titans. Bonuses stack and depend on the number of Fire Titans alive.
2 — Extra Damage against Earth Titans.
3 — Extra Defense against Earth Titans.
4 — %name% receives +400 Energy when using skills.
5 — Attacks of allied Fire Titans apply a mark that raises damage from Fire Titans for each mark applied.
6 — Reduces incoming damage by 50%.

14.name: Erupting Rage
14.description: Fires a powerful cannon shot, dealing damage to the closest enemy.

15.name: Burden of Creation
15.description: Raises a gigantic rock from the ground and launches it at the center of the enemy team. All nearby enemies receive damage.

16.name: Subterranean Prison
16.description: Binds a random enemy with roots and pulls the victim under the ground for %duration%. Once the enemy is released, they stay stunned for 2 more seconds. If the target is the last enemy on the battlefield, they won't get pulled underground, but the stun effect will still affect them.

17.name: Anger of the Earth
17.description: For %duration%, strikes the whole enemy team with roots coming from underground, dealing damage per second. Cannot attack while using the skill.

18.name: Emerald Storm
18.description: Shoots %hits% arrows at random targets, dealing damage with every hit.

19.name: Forest Embrace
19.description: Applies shield that absorbs damage to all allies.

20.name: Child of Nature
20.description:
For %duration%, summons Child of Nature in front of the allied team. Child of Nature doesn’t move and doesn’t attack but slows down enemies around it by %prime%%. Afterwards, it vanishes and stuns enemies for %hits% seconds.
Child of Nature is an Earth Titan and cannot be attacked.

21.name: Earth's Call
21.description:
Passive. Empowers allied Earth Titans. Bonuses stack and depend on the number of Earth Titans alive.
2 — Extra Damage against Water Titans.
3 — Extra Defense against Water Titans.
4 — %name% receives +400 Energy when using skills.
5 — Allied Earth Titans deal Extra Damage equal to %hits%% of current Health.
6 — Reduces incoming damage by 50%.

22.name: Scorching summoning
22.description: Summons the power of light to create a pillar of light at the center of the enemy team for %duration%. The pillar deals damage every second and slows down nearby enemies by %secondary%%.

23.name: Invoke Light
23.description: Grants a Light Particle to all allied Light Titans and the ally with the lowest health percentage for %duration%. The Light Particle protects the ally from the stun effect.

24.name: Vengeful Barrier
24.description: Casts a shield on the Hero that decreases the damage from the next %hits% attacks. When the shield is destroyed, stuns enemies in front of the Hero for %duration%.

25.name: Beacon of Life
25.description:
Applies the Beacon of Life for %duration% to other allied Light Titans and the ally with the lowest Health.
The Beacon restores Health and %secondary% energy per second.
Applies the Beacon to herself if there are no available targets.

26.name: Child of Light
26.description:
For %duration%, summons the Child of Light in front of the allied team. It does not move or attack, but its Health and Physical Attack scale with Lumira’s stats.

When the Child disappears, it grants Energy to the allied Titan with the lowest Energy. If there are no other targets, grants energy to Lumira. The amount restored is determined by the proportion of the Child’s remaining Health and cannot exceed 1000 Energy.

The Child of Light is considered a Light Titan and can be attacked. Allies’ abilities do not affect it.

27.name: Eternal Sunshine
27.description:
Passive. Empowers allied Light Titans. Bonuses stack and depend on the number of Light Titans that remain alive on the battlefield.

2 — Bonus to Extra Attack against Dark Titans.
3 — Bonus to Extra Defense against Dark Titans.
4 — %name% gains +400 Energy when using abilities.
5 — Allied Light Titans stun the enemy with the highest Physical Attack for %duration% upon using their first ability.
6 — Reduces incoming damage by 50%.

28.name: Stellar Destruction
28.description:
%name% shoots the nearest, the centermost, and the farthest enemy in sequence, dealing damage.
Hitting the same target deals 35% less damage. 
If there are stunned enemies on the battlefield at the moment of skill activation, all projectiles are launched at the nearest stunned enemy, dealing an additional area damage.

29.name: Touch of the Abyss
29.description:
Curses the nearest enemy for %duration%, prioritizing enemies not affected by the curse yet. The cursed enemy receives damage per second and cannot gain energy.
If the enemy dies while this curse is in effect, %secondary%% of their base attack and Health is transferred to all allied Dark Titans and the ally with the highest physical attack.

30.name: Eternal Sacrifice
30.description: Targets the enemy with the highest energy and burns %prime% of their energy, transferring it to Tenebris.

31.name: Wormhole
31.description: Applies a shield to the Hero that for %duration% absorbs all incoming damage and deals counter damage to the attacking enemy.

32.name: Essence Burnout
32.description: For %duration%, attacks the enemy in the center, dealing area damage.

33.name: Shadow Rampage
33.description: Curses the enemy with the highest attack, transferring part of their Health and attack to all allied Dark Titans and the nearest ally for %duration%.

34.name: Child of Darkness
34.description: Summons a Child of Darkness behind the enemy team. It does not move or attack, but drains %prime%% Energy from nearby enemies. After %duration%, it disappears and transfers all drained Energy to the allied Titan with the highest current Energy.

35.name: Shadow Bond
35.description:
Passive. Empowers allied Darkness Titans. Bonuses stack and depend on the number of Darkness Titans that remain alive on the battlefield.

2 – Bonus to Extra Attack against Light Titans.
3 – Bonus to Extra Defense against Light Titans.
4 – %name% gains +400 Energy when using abilities.
5 – Enemies lose %hits% Energy each time they take damage from Darkness Titans.
6 – Reduces damage taken by 50%.

36.name: Fate's Judgment
36.description:
Dashes behind the enemy with the highest Attack, strikes them and nearby enemies %hits% times, then returns to her position.

While this skill is active, she is immune to debuffs.

37.name: Devastating Link
37.description: Binds all allies to the enemy in the center for %duration%. Accumulates a portion of damage taken by allies and deals it to the enemy when the effect ends.

38.name: Elarite Ram
38.description: Attacks the nearest enemy and knocks them back. While in motion, the opponent deals damage to all enemies in their path.

39.name: Crystal Vortex
39.description:
Summons a whirlwind for %duration% that traps the central enemy. The whirlwind deals damage every %hits% sec. and moves the enemy around the battlefield.

While trapped in the whirlwind, the enemy cannot move, attack, or use skills.

40.name: Supreme Harmony
40.description:
Empowers allies for %duration%. The bonuses depend on the number of surviving Titans of each element:

1. For each Fire Titan, heals all allies every %param_hFrequency% sec.
2. For each Water Titan, increases all allies' Physical Attack.
3. For each Earth Titan, increases all allies' speed by %hits%%.
4. For each Elarite Titan, applies an effect to one ally. Whenever that ally deals damage, Metida lands an additional hit. Titans with the highest Attack are prioritized.

12.name: Into the Depths
12.description: Defeat Titans in the Guild Dungeon and receive gifts!

90210.name: Gift of the Titans
90210.description:
When the event ends, you won’t be able to reset Gift of the Elements levels!
Don't wait to upgrade the Gift of the Elements without spending gold! You only need Sparks of Power!
